Field.description: A labelled form field on UI SDK that wires its label, description and error to the control inside it.

Root.description: Groups one control with its label, description and error, and holds the field's invalid and disabled state.

invalid.description: Marks the control aria-invalid and data-invalid (the heavy outline), and shows a Field.Error that has no match at once.

disabled.description: Disables the control and mutes the label.

name.description: The control's name when the form is submitted.

Label.description: The visible label; it is the control's accessible name through a for/id pair set by UI SDK.

Description.description: A hint below the control, joined to its aria-describedby.

Error.description: The error message, joined to aria-describedby; it renders on match, or while the field is invalid (its prop, or a failed submit).

match.description: true renders it, even when disabled; false never. A ValidityState key renders it for that native check once a submit fails it.

useWhen: Any text input, so it has a visible label, an optional hint and an error said in words.

avoidWhen.text: One question answered with several controls, such as a set of radios.

a11y: Give every Field.Root a Field.Label; a placeholder is not a label.
When the value is wrong, set invalid on Field.Root and match on Field.Error, and say what to fix in words.
Put format rules in Field.Description before the person types, not only in the error.

Input.description: A text input; inside Field.Root it takes the field's label, description, error and invalid and disabled state.

type.description: The native input type: text, email, password, search, tel, url, number.

readOnly.description: Shows a value that cannot be edited on a layer fill; it stays focusable and is still submitted.

autoComplete.description: The autofill hint, such as email, name or current-password.

useWhen: One line of text inside Field.Root: a name, an email, a URL, a search term.

avoidWhen.text: The text runs to more than one line.
The person picks from a fixed short list.

a11y: Place it inside Field.Root with a Field.Label; on its own it has no name unless you give it aria-label.
Set autoComplete on fields that ask for the person's own data, such as email or name.
